node.statement: Target corner algebra and target projections. Apply lem-compcb-corner-algebra to the nonvanishing t-projection P_R in the extended epsilon_A-C*-algebra A: epsilon_A+t<=2t<=e_ca, hence A_R=S^A_{P_R}, with compressed unit I_{A_R}=u_R=Co^A_{P_R}(P_R), is an extended 2*C_ca*t-C*-algebra. Apply lem-maincb-nested-corner-comparison with (R,P,Q)=(P_R,P_U,P_V), using the four subordination estimates from node 1.2 and t<=e_nest. It gives P_U^R=Co^A_{P_R}(P_U) and P_V^R=Co^A_{P_R}(P_V) as C_nest*t-projections in A_R. Their projection defects and the target ambient defect are therefore all at most C_cross*t.
